info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Webhook Test Subscriptions-spec
info.description: The Webhook Test Subscription Management API enables developers to list and manage test subscriptions for a specific webhook identified by the webhookId. This API is essential for applications that need to verify the functionality of webhook notifications in a testing environment. Typical users include application developers and QA engineers who require efficient management of test subscriptions to ensure proper integration and performance. By leveraging this API, consumers can streamline the testing process and ensure reliability in their notification workflows.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the test subscriptions for a specific webhook resource identified by RES-100045. It provides valuable insights into the current subscriptions set up for testing purposes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate the test subscriptions for the webhook identified by RES-100045. It provides the necessary parameters to the API for testing the webhook's functionality.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the test subscriptions for the specified webhook.
